verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure that agents call as a tool. Acting as an MCP client, loading external MCP servers and invoking their tools, is not a role this kind of product plays. The evidence shows only the opposite role: AgentMail hosts its own MCP server for other clients to use, and that server-side capability does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
